editorial_checks: Two distinct histories, not matched success/failure scores or a linear hierarchy of institutional capacity. The front-end prose does not use SAE dimension labels.
Montreal's adoption in 1987, the 1990 amendment, the interim fund from January 1991 and the amendment's August 1992 entry into force remain distinct.

Article 5 eligibility and the conditional notification route are not generalized to every developing country or a unilateral right to suspend any obligation. Agreed incremental costs are not an entitlement to reimbursement of every expense.

Article 10 voting requires two-thirds overall plus majorities in both groups after consensus efforts fail; it is not merely two separate majorities, donor control, or a complete description of Executive Committee voting.

India's quota, compensation and audited production changes are attributed to the World Bank's completion record. The August 2008 phase-out explicitly preserves authorized pharmaceutical essential uses.

The official April 2012 committee report independently anchors the documentation questions, deferral and offer of assistance. A deferred payment is not a finding that prior production reductions were invented. No final later payment or verification outcome is supplied.

The funding Executive Committee, non-compliance Implementation Committee, domestic government and enterprises have separate powers. Assistance/warnings/suspension are not a mandatory escalating staircase.

Project outputs, atmospheric recovery and personal distributional outcomes require different evidence; enterprise compensation does not prove that every worker or small repair business was adequately supported.

Smallpox surveillance was already part of the 1967 intensified programme; later emphasis did not abolish vaccination or instantly replace every national practice. Henderson's account and archival historians are identified, not conflated with a neutral final verdict.
Zero reports, zero transmission, a last known natural case and certification are distinct. At least two years of effective surveillance is not an automatic calendar-based certificate.

The 104 rumours from 40 countries are direct reports to WHO, not confirmed cases or all local rumours. The report/table discrepancy about the chickenpox/measles share is not reproduced and no ratio is given.
The 1978 Birmingham laboratory-associated cases prevent last natural case from becoming last case of any origin. Global certification and retained investigation/precautions coexist.

Greenough's accessible abstract supports a limited attributed claim about coercive episodes and resentment; no individual scene, global prevalence or necessity of coercion is reconstructed. Bhattacharya's archived correspondence is read through his original research, not claimed to have been independently opened.

No composite victims, invented dialogue or private thoughts. National participation does not manufacture individual consent; historical achievement does not validate every intervention, and abuses do not erase all benefits.

Montreal stops with the 2012 records discussed; smallpox with 1980 certification and policy arrangements. Later explanatory sources are marked retrospective; no current legal, medical or vaccination prescription is offered.
